notes.title: We are out of Early Access! Thank you!
notes.content:
Thank you all for great support! Now we are officially out of Early Access so the game is now available in full, completed and stable version. We are very glad that we completed the game successfully. We couldn't finish the game without YOU! Thanks again!

What was fixed and what was added?

Added
• Post effects
• Color correction
• Full multiplayer
• Completed campaign
• In-game voices & sounds
• Tutorial improvements
• Final game stats

Fixed
• AI [AI was freezing and stucking into ground]
• Locomotion movement [more smooth]
• In-game battle atmosphere [not too much chaos]
• Player progression
• Introduction
• Multiplayer server browser
• Sync problems

Please if you find some bugs or issues, write them here to the pinned thread
TFO - Bug Reports & Questions pinned thread
We are aware of our mistakes and bugs, so we would like to fix every detail that we didn't notice. Thank you!

- TFO team

We would like to show you TFO titles history

The very first title [February 2017]

notes.title: TFO VR Second Beta Release Finally Available
notes.content:
The new update is finally here and you can look forward on many new fixes and features including performance optimization, AI improvements, new soundtracks, shader improvements, added new GUI Effects and first test of multiplayer mode!

The fifth release contains:
- Fixed FPS drops
- Fixed Beamsword lacks
- Fixed AI glitches
- Added new soundtracks
- Added extra statistics
- Added final battle results
- Added first online multiplayer mode [Early Alpha]
- Added extra GUI effects

We really appreciate every new support and we are trying to do our best to bring you an incredible experience. We are very sorry for a late that we had. We've finally figured out the server issues and now it's ready for testing. Please if you have any issues in Online Matches, write to the pinned discussion here.

The next release date is not release, because we'd like to fix last and well-known issues and add last promised features to release the game as a full title. We hope you will stay with us and make the game done! We will do the best to make your experience even much better!

- TFO Team.

notes.title: Update Delayed - Server Problems
notes.content:
TFO VR Second Beta release is delayed. We are having a little server problems. We want to make the first early alpha multiplayer playable and well working. We are very sorry for this issue and we hope you will stay with us! We need your help to improve the game. Thank you for your patience!

The new update will bring you new features such as updated menu, fixed many glitches and the first multiplayer. Actually the official date for the update is not released. We don't know how long the issue will take.

But we have also a great news! The game is in the +30% sale. The sale will be active the whole christmas time. So keep checking and sharing if you do not own the game yet! Thank you!

- Early Alpha testing shot from the Multiplayer scene [Michael & Matt]

notes.title: TFO VR First Beta Release Available
notes.content:
Welcome to Beta version! It's finally here. The new update contains many new amazing things such as new menu style, new maps, optimized performance, fixed many bugs [Covers logic, AI teleportation...]. This time, we've focused on player's psychology and more realistic environment.

The fourth release contains:
- Fixed FPS drops
- Fixed VR Character drops
- Fixed In-Game Menu
- New Maps
- Updated Menu Style
- Updated Game Style
- Added Statistics
- Optimized Game Performance

We are very glad that you are still with us and following the entire TFO VR development. Thank you for all your support! In the upcoming version [TFO VR Second Beta Release] we would like to implement first multiplayer logic, so you can look forward for the first multiplayer matches!

The next release date is 12/12/2017. It's a magical date and almost the end of the year 2017! That means, we are very close to the full game release. We will do the best to make your experience even much better.

notes.title: TFO Alpha Second Release official date
notes.content:
The Frontier Outskirts VR is going very well and we've got great news for you. TFO Alpha First Release is currently online and we are very glad that you keep following the latest news of TFO. The game is going to be very interesting now, because next release will bring a lot of amazing features like VR character, space battles and more.

Thank you very much for the reviews and suggestions. We appreciate every comment and feedback. Only community pushes us forward!

Official release date of TFO Alpha Second Release is 1st August 2017.

Upcoming new features:

 VR Character
 Space Battles
 New Movement Modes
 Improved Troops AI
 New Map
 Updated Game Style


• VR Character
You will be finally able to see your whole virtual body. The first type of character will take you to the incredible battle atmosphere.

• Space Battles
The big next feature of the game are space battles. We are very happy to introduce you this great feature. The upcoming version will include first space map called Star Primes and first collection of spaceships with interiors.

• New Movement Modes
New movement modes is very helpful feature, because a lot of people don't like locomotion movement. So we added many more movement modes. Upcoming version will include 3 new movement modes with a lot of settings. Locomotion (you will be able to set up all settings for loco mode), Teleportation (Teleportation speed and many more settings will be available) and Touchpad movement (you will be able to set up settings as you wish as well). We really care of your comfort in the game...

• Improved AI
Soldiers will be able to find their own covers much quicker than before. Accuracy and movement flexibility will be also improved.

• New Map
New map for Ground Mode will be something new for TFO. It's a map of Jungle type. It's called The Forest Occupation. More you will see in the game or on the screenshots.

• Updated Game Style
As the game moves forward, we really want to update game style as much as it's possible. It's more futuristic!

Thank you very much for reading latest news and we hope you will stay with us! Enjoy and thanks again!!!

Here is some demo shots from upcoming version (Space battles and The Forrest Occupation map for Ground Mode)
- The Forest Occupation [In campaign and custom mode]
https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohrywXeLQyWhHsfeM/giphy.gif
- Space Battles (first map and first collection of space ships)
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUA7bdL73waa3dTSF2/giphy.gif

notes.title: TFO in Early Access
notes.content:
First of all, we would like to apologize for our big mistake that the game was not listed as an Early Access. There was a few technical problems in transaction and in the game release. We are very glad that you like the actual game and respect the game content just in the Alpha version. 

As you probably know, the game is the Early Access and we have a few information for you...

We plan plenty of things and features to the future this year like VR character and multiplayer. It could be very big fun to fight against/ with your friends on the virtual battlefield. VR Character is very important for us to see your virtual hands and body. There will also many more maps, weapons, enemies, modes... One of the biggest features are space-battles that will be available soon.

This is the official list we plan to the future

• VR Character
• Multiplayer battles
• At least 5 maps
• At least 3 game modes
• Space battles
• Character customization

Most important thing for us is listen to the community. We have already noticed some new suggestions from the community and we very appreciate that.

Thank you all for understanding and we hope you will be very satisfied with the future game features.

- TFO Team

notes.title: Technical Problems
notes.content:
We have recently noticed that the game cannot be sold and the community reported transaction issues. We have already contacted Steam administration and we're waiting for respond from their side. Thank you for being with us and we look forward for your first impressions!

- TFO Team.

notes.title: TFO VR is ready
notes.content:
Welcome to the official store page of The Frontier Outskirts VR. Main store page is now officialy online and we are receiving first impressions and reviews. First game release [Alpha] is coming up on 11th June 2017.

The first game release contains:
• 2 Maps
• 2 Game modes
• First collection of beam swords and weapons
• Enemies and allies
• Interactive environment
• Locomotion movement system

Please notice that the game will be available on 11th June, we do not provide any pre-order keys.

What's the plan to the future?
We plan plenty of things and features to the future this year like VR character and multiplayer. It could be very big fun to fight against/ with your friends on the virtual battlefield. VR Character is very important for us to see your virtual hands, body etc. We will also add many more maps, weapons, enemies, modes... One of the biggest features are space-battles that will be available very soon.

Why TFO VR?
We are small indie game development studio and we haven't seen any VR game of this type. So we've made one. We are full of passion to develop something, where you can literally choose your equipment, battlefield and experience the true futuristic war atmosphere. Everything is about your choice, your feelings.

If you were interested in this game, please keep following the latest news and leave a comment of what should be improved and what'd you like to see in the future releases. Creators don't create game, community create game.

Thank you so much for your attention and we hope you will have a big fun from the game!

- TFO developers team
